concern: دیں (subjunctive/imperative of dena, in \"चھوڑ دیں\") is written \"dein\", but ADR 0005 R2 requires nasal verb forms (karen, den, len, rahen) to stay single-vowel and never take -ein; only oblique plural pronouns (unhein, tumhein, hamein, jinhein) get -ein. The corpus uses \"den\" for this verb 107 times against 12 stray \"dein\" spellings, this verse being one of them.
suggestion: Ab aap un ka khayaal chhod den aur muntazir rahen.
